derivedFrom: kimi-cli 1.52.0 wheel (PyPI) source; the kimi binary is not installed on the spike host

default_model.note: must name an entry of [models] (validator), else load fails

default_yolo.note: auto-approve; app.py: yolo = flag or config.default_yolo

acpEntry.earlyReturn: kimi_cli/cli/__init__.py main callback: `if ctx.invoked_subcommand is not None: return`, so options before `acp` (--model, --thinking) are ignored
acpEntry.configLocation: set_model asserts the default config location and rewrites <share>/config.toml via save_config (default_model, default_thinking)

permissions.toolsThatNeverAsk: file read, glob, grep, web search/fetch (no ask rules exist)
permissions.fsDelegation: with client fs capabilities, reads go to fs/read_text_file and writes to fs/write_text_file (ACPKaos)
permissions.terminalDelegation: shell runs through the client terminal only when the client advertises terminal

projectInstructions: AGENTS.md (or agents.md) and .kimi/AGENTS.md from the nearest .git root down to the work dir are ALWAYS loaded (no trust gate); without .git only the work dir itself

login.flow: device authorization: POST <oauth host>/api/oauth/device_authorization; polls the token endpoint every interval seconds; restarts when the code expires
login.opensBrowser: webbrowser.open(url) unless it fails; set BROWSER to a no-op on a server
